user.title: Energy Tariff Assistant
user.description: One entry per metering point (e.g. your main meter, or a controlled-load circuit). Choose where the tariff plan comes from.

data_description.source: The library and Share need internet access during setup only; the plan is stored locally afterwards.

meters.title: Energy meters
meters.description:
Plan: {plan}

Choose the cumulative energy sensors (kWh) to meter against this plan. Leave a sensor empty to get prices only for that side.

data_description.import_sensor: A total or total-increasing energy sensor for energy bought from the grid.
data_description.export_sensor: A total or total-increasing energy sensor for energy fed into the grid.
data_description.billing_day: Day of the month your bill period starts (1-28).

share.title: Share this plan
share.description:
Plan: {plan}

This opens the plan submission form on GitHub with this plan filled in: rates, times, retailer and region only. Nothing about your home, meters or usage is included, and nothing is sent from Home Assistant: check the form, then submit it from your own GitHub account.

**[Open the plan submission form]({url})**

Submit here to close this window.
